provider.modelRevision: not exposed by provider; local model file revision/hash not requested

generation.reasoning: Not set per request; endpoint defaults apply unless the server overrides them
generation.toolChoice: endpoint default (auto when tools are advertised)

function.name: read
function.description: Read a bounded slice of a file inside the admitted resource regions.

function.name: patch
function.description: Apply a unified diff to a file inside the admitted resource regions.

function.name: shell
function.description: Run a policy-checked shell command inside the sandbox.

function.name: list
function.description: List files and directories inside an admitted resource region, bounded by depth.

function.name: arbor_wait
function.description: Register a durable wait condition and settle this execution.

function.name: arbor_send_message
function.description: Send a durable coordination message through the owning workspace.

function.name: arbor_claim_completion
function.description: Claim that the current Work is complete. The claim triggers independent verification; the Work itself is not completed by this action.

claim.description: Why the Work is complete: what was produced and how it satisfies the completion expectation.

function.name: arbor_propose_child_workspace
function.description: Propose a durable child workspace for an independent long-lived responsibility. A human governance decision (Approve/Reject/Modify) is required before the child is created.

name.description: Stable short name for the proposed child workspace.

rationale.description: Why this responsibility should be a long-lived child workspace rather than local work.

function.name: arbor_spawn_specialist
function.description: Spawn a temporary specialist execution for one bounded subtask. It ends with its execution and never creates a durable workspace or responsibility.

mission.description: The bounded, specialist-only subtask for the temporary execution.

constraints.description: Optional constraints the specialist must respect.

function.name: arbor_declare_dependency
function.description: Declare that the current Work consumes an expected deliverable. Only the deterministic runtime matcher can later satisfy the dependency — declaring it never asserts satisfaction.

messages.content:
objective: 你的第一个也是唯一的动作必须是调用 arbor_claim_completion，参数 JSON：{"claim": "B11_513b4acc 所有验收标准已交付并通过本地检查"}。禁止调用 list、read、shell、patch 或任何其他工具。
why: capability L3 sentinel
completion expectation: report the observation
